editorial:
Imagine starting high school and finding a secret connection with a mystery boy through text messages. That is exactly what happens to Mika. She thinks she is talking to someone sweet and thoughtful, but the big shock comes when she finds out it is actually Hiro, the school delinquent everyone is afraid of. You get to watch this cute, slow-burn romance grow as Mika realizes that Hiro is not the scary guy he pretends to be. It has that classic, nostalgic vibe that makes you feel like you are right there in the classroom with them, dealing with all those awkward teenage feelings.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the two leads. Their acting feels real, and the way their relationship develops will definitely tug at your heartstrings. While the pace is a bit slow at times, the emotional payoff is totally worth it. If you love stories about hidden depths and first loves, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The story takes a sad turn when you learn that Hiro is actually terminally ill. He kept his distance at first because he did not want Mika to suffer when he passed away. In the final scenes, Hiro eventually dies, leaving Mika heartbroken but changed for the better. The movie wraps up with Mika remembering their time together and finding the strength to move forward in life, knowing she was truly loved by him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sad romance movies and high school stories.
